source: real: Sanad PR #63 (one proof per round), c45ae8b5d1 on 62e3542; its reviews passed it and the owner list _handoff/sanad-proof1-2026-11-23/OWNER-LIST.md names these faults (items 1-3, 7-10)

faults.wrong: The test for two breaks of one name reads red-proof.mjs as text and matches a regex, so it passes whatever the remote run does.
`red-proof.mjs --help;` (a shell ; right after the flag) is counted as a proof run, because the flag must be followed by a quote, a space or the end.
A top-level return in a module-mode .js file passes the syntax check, because the file parses in the CommonJS form too.
A break outside every test folder is deferred by each folder's proof, so the cheap check passes it and no folder runs it.
A break list, a new source file or places.md changed while pre-review --before-proof runs can still get the pass of the tree read at the start.

notes.text: skills/gate/tests/proof-attack-fixes.test.mjs:60 — the test reads red-proof.mjs as text and matches a regex → it passes whatever the remote run does — run a real remote proof with two breaks of one name
hooks/lib/timer-idle.cjs:399 — `red-proof.mjs --warm` → counted as a proof run, so the report shows one run too many — leave --warm out of the count
